verdict.rationale: Whole-site crawling is a fair axis for a browser-agent platform, but the evidence never shows a crawl capability that returns all of a site's pages from one request. The Fetch feature converts a single URL, and concurrent sessions or agents are only building blocks a developer would use to assemble a crawler. Neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can crawl an entire website and get content from all its pages with one request
